feelings.title: Feelings!
feelings.menu: Pick one! Let's feel with Heidi, or guess how Heidi feels!
feelings.explore_intro: Let's explore feelings with Heidi! Tap a face!
feelings.c_happy: Happy! I feel happy. Smiling makes me happy!
feelings.c_sad: Sad. When I'm sad, a hug helps.

feelings.c_scared: Scared. It's okay. I'm safe. A hug helps.
feelings.c_sleepy: Sleepy. Yawn. Time for a cozy rest.
feelings.c_silly: Silly! Hee hee! I'm being silly!
feelings.c_love: Love! I love you so much!
